title: MarsOrtho Benchmark
subtitle: Cross-sensor SR benchmark from Mastcam-Z + HiRISE
description:
MarsOrtho is the first cross-sensor super-resolution benchmark for Mars, derived from Perseverance Mastcam-Z (HR, ~6.25cm/px) and MRO HiRISE (LR, ~25cm/px) co-registered via SPICE kernels.

- Train: 281 patches from 48 sols
- Test: 40 patches from 7 sols
- Patch sizes: HR 256x256, LR 64x64 (x4 SR)
- Coverage: Jezero Crater, Mars
